scope: Director Cut PRO namespace only; shared legacy grants outside DCP were preserved, not audited or hardened.
summary: DCP authorization uses the Firebase Auth UID in the path. Both create and update validate fields, size and revision. Shared recursive grants exclude DCP. Live browser/SDK checks cover owner lifecycle, foreign-user read/list/update/delete denial, foreign Storage access denial, invalid fields/revisions/MIME denial, and temporary-account cleanup.

findings.issue: The editor payload is size-limited JSON text. Rules validate the envelope but cannot validate the JSON structure, so an owner using their own API client can corrupt their own project.
findings.recommendation: Add a versioned payload parser/migration layer when supporting third-party project imports or future schema versions. No authority or entitlement is taken from the payload.

findings.issue: Firebase download URLs contain bearer tokens. Rules prevent other accounts from discovering files through the SDK, but a recipient of a deliberately shared download URL can retrieve that file.
findings.recommendation: For a future strict-private-media requirement, replace token URLs with an authenticated media delivery service supporting video range requests.
